summary: Level-5 and Sony's fantasy RPG series spanning two PlayStation 3 games and a PSP prequel.

entries.title: White Knight Chronicles
entries.definitive_edition: White Knight Chronicles II included remaster

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps and validate stability for both the original-story remaster and sequel content.

primary.version: White Knight Chronicles II included remaster via RPCS3
primary.why: White Knight Chronicles II includes a fully remastered version of the original game on the same Blu-ray disc, making it the most complete and improved route for the first game's story.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped White Knight Chronicles II disc in RPCS3 and start from the beginning of the whole story. Original PS3 hardware is the fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is bundled inside White Knight Chronicles II rather than sold as a separate modern remaster.

entries.title: White Knight Chronicles II

emulation.notes: Use legal disc dumps and test the current compatibility profile before a full run.

primary.why: White Knight Chronicles II only released on PlayStation 3; RPCS3 is the highest-fidelity capture route for the complete sequel.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PlayStation 3 disc in RPCS3. Start the sequel directly if you have already played the included remaster of the first game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster exists; online-era features may be historically limited, but the single-player sequel remains on disc.

entries.title: White Knight Chronicles: Origins

emulation.notes: Use legal UMD dumps; choose the European/Australian release for English-language coverage where appropriate.

primary.why: Origins is a PSP prequel and was not released in North America; PPSSPP gives the cleanest capture route for the European/Japanese/Australian release.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped PSP UMD image in PPSSPP with a stable resolution scale and the region/language release you want to cover.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake/remaster exists; North America did not receive an official release.
